Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art source atlas for top-down overworld FOG, later reduced to exact native pixels, not finished transparency. Draw on perfectly flat solid pure magenta #ff00ff. Square 1536x1536 canvas. A precise 3-column by 4-row atlas of TWELVE separate fog bank drawings, one centered in each equally sized cell, generous magenta margins, no grid, no lettering. Each is a distinct, low, porous irregular bank seen straight down, with internal magenta openings. Not a side-view cloud. Each uses crisp square pixel clusters and stair-step edges. Draw at large size with blocks about 6-8 source pixels, no blur or dither. Palette ONLY four opaque flat colors: muted blue-grey #adbfc5, pale grey #c8d6d8, light grey #e1e8e6, tiny restrained ivory #f1f3eb. Most area is the first TWO colors, highlights in quiet disconnected patches occupying less than one tenth of each bank. Top-left illumination. Soft impression is obtained by nested flat pixel-cluster patches, never airbrush. Do NOT draw bright outline ridges, whitecaps, hooked crests, long curved highlight lines, combs, stripes, diagonal brush strokes, round cloud puffs, black outline, smears, speckles, isolated pixels, perspective or ground. All banks visibly different, varied footprints and open negative spaces, no repeated clones. Intended native footprints about 35-65 pixels wide and 18-35 pixels tall.
Variant A: muted fragmented ground mist. Twelve asymmetrical branching, interlocking low patches with compact quiet interiors. Alternate broad and narrow footprints, sometimes two connected masses, occasional oblique ragged tips but no consistent diagonal direction. Do not make them all horizontal streaks. Banks should look almost subdued at source, NOT bright stylized gusts.
